summary: A split-screen user authentication page featuring a branded testimonial side and a comprehensive login form with password recovery, remember-me functionality, and Google SSO.

stack.name: React + Vite
stack.why: Fast development setup for modern single-page applications.

stack.name: Tailwind CSS
stack.why: Utility-first CSS framework ideal for rapid layout and design token implementation.

stack.name: Lucide React
stack.why: Provides clean icons like the Google logo and checkbox components.

components.name: AuthLayout
components.purpose: Splits the screen into a left testimonial panel and a right login form container.

components.name: TestimonialPanel
components.purpose: Displays the brand logo, customer quote, and author details on a gradient background.

components.name: LoginForm
components.purpose: Manages user inputs, validation, and submission for email and password.

components.name: Button
components.purpose: Reusable button for primary actions and third-party login.

steps.title: Project Setup
steps.detail: Initialize a new React project with Vite and Tailwind CSS. Configure global styles and base typography to match the design.

steps.title: Build AuthLayout Component
steps.detail: Create a responsive flex/grid container dividing the viewport into the left gradient panel and the right light-gray login surface.

steps.title: Implement TestimonialPanel
steps.detail: Add the brand logo at the top, center the customer quote vertically, and place the author info at the bottom over the blue gradient background.

steps.title: Construct LoginForm Component
steps.detail: Build the input fields for Work email and Password with labels and placeholder text. Add the 'Remember me' checkbox and 'Forgot password?' link.

steps.title: Add Action Buttons and Divider
steps.detail: Implement the primary 'Log in' button, the 'or' separator line, and the 'Continue with Google' button with its associated icon.

steps.title: Wire Up Interactivity and State
steps.detail: Manage controlled inputs for email and password, handle form submission, and implement validation or error states for failed logins.

steps.title: Responsive Refinement
steps.detail: Ensure the layout gracefully stacks on mobile viewports by hiding the testimonial side or moving it above the form.

behaviour: Log in button validates inputs and submits POST request to authentication API, displaying loading spinners and error messages on failure.
Remember me checkbox stores a persistent session token or long-lived refresh token.
Forgot password link navigates to password recovery view.
Continue with Google button initiates OAuth 2.0 flow via Google identity provider.
data: OAuth redirect parameters for Google sign-in
